Bottom navigation bar with 5 rounded chunky icons: wallet, gift/transfer, shop, quests, market-stall. Rounded thick UI cards, soft drop shadows, delightful immersive kids game interface. Polished high-quality mobile game UI, Dribbble showcase quality, clean readable layout.
